WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat,
         AVG(CAST(m.facetresmm AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(m.geomdeltamm AS REAL), 0)) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS mesh_count
  FROM sites AS s
  JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE m.facetresmm IS NOT NULL
    AND m.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.geomdeltamm AS REAL) <> 0
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  WHERE insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY insurstat
), above_average AS (
  SELECT r.insurstat, r.avg_ratio, a.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios AS r
  JOIN status_averages AS a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat
  WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT insurstat,
       AVG(avg_ratio) AS above_average_sites_avg_ratio,
       COUNT(*) AS above_average_site_count,
       AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM above_average
GROUP BY insurstat
